clue.text: Dog about to get spirited? Fat cats may enjoy that!

parts.note: Pluto is the cartoon dog in Disney films
C is short for circa, Latin for about
racy means lively or spirited

explanation.surface: A dog is about to become frisky, and wealthy fat cats would enjoy the sight.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a playful description: fat cats, the very rich, would naturally enjoy a system run by people like themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Government by the wealthy is exactly the system rich 'fat cats' would favour.

clue.text: Left harbour

definitions.meaning: the left-hand side of a ship, looking forward
a town or haven where ships dock

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are nautical: the ship's left side, and a haven where vessels shelter and unload.

clue.text: Lacking knowledge, a foreign king in play comes to nasty end

parts.note: un is French for a
King Lear is the title character of Shakespeare's tragedy

indicators.note: something nasty is foul or twisted, so the following word is jumbled

explanation.surface: An ignorant foreign king in a stage play meets a grisly death.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone untaught or uneducated is without knowledge, which is the adjective's meaning.

clue.text: Place of refreshment has nothing unaltered

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
as is means left unchanged, as in 'sold as is'

explanation.surface: A café or pub boasts that nothing about it has been changed.
explanation.definitionFit: A fertile spot in a desert with water, where travellers are refreshed; also used of any restful haven.

clue.text: Admonish agent wandering

parts.note: a rep, or representative, acts as an agent for a firm
to rove is to wander

explanation.surface: Someone tells off a sales agent who keeps straying from the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean to scold or rebuke someone for a fault.

clue.text: Food like beetroot served up in stew

parts.note: chow is slang for food

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the word is placed upwards, bottom to top

parts.note: beetroot is deep red

explanation.surface: A dish containing something beetroot-coloured is dished up in a stew.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick soup-like stew, typically of fish or clams with potatoes.

clue.text: Something deceitful in this campaign

indicators.note: in shows the letters are lying inside the words this campaign

explanation.surface: There is trickery at the heart of this political campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindle or con trick is a dishonest scheme meant to deceive.

clue.text: Set of bells that man installed in church

indicators.note: installed in means one piece is fitted inside the other

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
him refers to that man

explanation.surface: A man fits a ring of bells in a church tower.
explanation.definitionFit: A carillon or tuned set of bells can be called by this name, as can the sound they make.

clue.text: Remote inns supply vegetable soup

indicators.note: supply read as supple-y, bending and flexible, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Country inns far from anywhere serve vegetable soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' is the rearrangement signal, read as the adverb from supple.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian soup thick with vegetables, beans and pasta.

clue.text: Issuing some edict, a Tory tyrant

indicators.note: some of the letters issue from the words edict a Tory, which carry the word inside them

explanation.surface: A Conservative despot hands down a decree.
explanation.definitionFit: An absolute ruler wielding total power is a despot or tyrant.

clue.text: Starts making things in the bakery

definitions.meaning: a film camera ... when shooting starts, so production begins
bread buns baked in small rounds

explanation.definitionFit: Cameras start turning to make a film, and bakers sell small round loaves of bread.

clue.text: Something provided for eyesight

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
vision is the faculty of sight

explanation.surface: An optician supplies something for your sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A supply or arrangement made in advance is a thing provided.

clue.text: Power when weapon gives means to enter camp?

parts.note: P is the symbol for power in physics
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
a sword is a bladed weapon

explanation.surface: A soldier at a camp gate wonders whether armed force gets one inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentries demand a secret word before letting anyone into a military camp.

clue.text: Anxiety when head's lost hair

indicators.note: the head, the first letter, is dropped from the word

parts.note: stress is worry or anxiety

explanation.surface: Worry makes someone lose the hair from their head.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock or long strand of a person's locks is a poetic word for hair.

clue.text: Various locations (about a hundred) to give one smashing images

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around another piece
various suggests different arrangements of the word's letters

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Images get smashed in assorted places by a crowd of around a hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Various' rearranges LOCATIONS; 'about' puts that around C.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a breaker of religious icons; by extension someone who attacks cherished beliefs.

clue.text: Lock up prisoner? Excellent!

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner
fine means very good, excellent

explanation.surface: Someone cheers at the news that a criminal will be jailed.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut someone in or imprison them, keeping them within limits.

clue.text: Pioneer at home with computer technology at end of line

parts.note: in means at home, as in 'staying in'
IT stands for information technology
the letter I, like the Roman one, is drawn as a single straight line

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of the word line

explanation.surface: A tech pioneer works from home on computers until the end of the line.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a verb. 'line' does double duty: as a single upright stroke it gives I (the Roman numeral one), and its last letter gives E after AT.
explanation.definitionFit: To pioneer something is to start or set it going, which is what this verb means.

clue.text: Out of rubbish I am afraid will emerge a small animal

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish

indicators.note: the a comes out of the phrase, so that letter is removed

parts.note: I am afraid can be put as I fear

explanation.surface: Someone fears a tiny creature will crawl out of a pile of garbage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of ... will emerge' takes A out of I FEAR, leaving IFER; the 'a' before 'small animal' does double duty in the surface but is the removed letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A microscopic aquatic invertebrate with a wheel-like ring of cilia, a tiny creature.

clue.text: The fellow's entering country to get commercial concession

indicators.note: entering means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: France is a European country
his means belonging to the fellow

explanation.surface: A man goes into France to secure a licence to trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A licence granted by a company letting another trade under its brand is a business concession.

clue.text: No n-noise? One's falling asleep

parts.note: taken as written
the stammered n-noise is a stuttered version of a noise; ding is a ringing noise, and stammering its start gives d-ding

explanation.surface: Someone stammers a plea for quiet while drifting off to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: The stutter in 'n-noise' tells you to repeat the first letter of the noise word: DING becomes D-DING.
explanation.definitionFit: Dozing off, the head drops forward; 'one's falling asleep' describes a person dropping off.

clue.text: Walk right into cooking area

indicators.note: into means one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: a galley is a ship's or aircraft's kitchen

explanation.surface: Someone strolls straight into the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A long covered walkway or balcony, a passage for walking along.

clue.text: Sure to want new leader to be relevant

indicators.note: the word needs a different first letter, so its opening letter is replaced

parts.note: certain means sure

explanation.surface: Someone is convinced a fresh leader is needed to stay relevant.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue does not say which letter is the new leader; crossing letters supply P.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate or apply to something is to have relevance to it.

clue.text: Playwright harbouring love for dog

indicators.note: harbouring means holding another piece inside

parts.note: Harold Pinter was an English playwright
love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: A dramatist shelters a beloved dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed of gundog that stands rigid indicating where game lies.

clue.text: Vehicle one needed to go round quiet island

indicators.note: to go round means the first pieces encircle the next

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
p is the musical marking piano, quiet
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A single car is needed to drive around a peaceful island.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian island in the Bay of Naples, a well-known resort.

clue.text: Board offering eleventh scheme?

parts.note: a plan is a scheme
K is the eleventh letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A committee board offers its eleventh proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: A long flat piece of timber is a board.

clue.text: Help bishop in need to be easy-going

indicators.note: in means the first pieces go inside the other

parts.note: lack means want or need
aid means help
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Assisting a needy bishop calls for a relaxed temperament.
explanation.definitionFit: Relaxed and unhurried, untroubled by pressure.

clue.text: Roger or Francis — which is rasher?

definitions.meaning: Roger was a medieval friar-philosopher and Francis an Elizabethan statesman and essayist, both with this surname

explanation.definitionFit: Two famous thinkers share the surname, and a rasher is a slice of cured pig meat.

clue.text: Report of drinking bout brings cries of disapproval

indicators.note: report means the word is as heard, a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a booze is informally a drinking session

explanation.surface: News of a heavy drinking session draws jeers.
explanation.definitionFit: Jeers shouted by an unhappy audience are noises of disapproval.

clue.text: Room in a hospital department to accommodate dishevelled tramp

indicators.note: to accommodate means the outer pieces take the jumbled word inside them

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

indicators.note: dishevelled means messed up, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A hospital ward makes room for a scruffy vagrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A single room or suite of rooms used as living quarters; a flat.

clue.text: City company being ventilated, it appears

indicators.note: being here means the firm has something put inside it

parts.note: to ventilate a room is to let air into it

explanation.surface: A firm seems to be airing its views about a city.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Egypt, a city on the Nile.

clue.text: To catch fish — not hard after short time

indicators.note: after means the following piece comes later than the T

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time

indicators.note: not hard means the abbreviation for hard is dropped from the fish

parts.note: hake is a sea fish

explanation.surface: An angler catches a soft fish after a short wait.
explanation.definitionFit: To seize or capture something, as in landing a catch.

clue.text: Unusual garden has to include the latest in fancy shrubs

indicators.note: to include means the jumbled letters hold another letter inside them
unusual signals the letters are set out in an odd arrangement
the latest means the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: An odd garden contains the newest fashionable bushes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusual' looks like a comment on the garden but is the rearrangement signal; 'to include' wraps the jumble round the last letter of 'fancy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Flowering bushes with big rounded heads of pink, blue or white blooms.
